pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 11.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: NON- FICTION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: what he or she has read about. 1. What is the importance of reading widely?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify print and non- print non-fiction materials that are interesting to read
2. read a range of non- fiction materials for general information

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify print and non- print non-fiction materials that are interesting to read
   In simple words: practise until you can identify print and non- print non-fiction materials that are interesting to read. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. read a range of non- fiction materials for general information
   In simple words: practise until you can read a range of non- fiction materials for general information. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction.
4. Show that you can: identify print and non- print non-fiction materials that are interesting to read

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the general ideas with peers,
2. Read various texts on risky behaviour by road users and note the key points,
3. Self-efficacy: It is enhanced as the learner selects reading materials to enhance their ability to make decisions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. what he or she has read about. 1. What is the importance of reading widely?
2. What do you consider when selecting a reading text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify print and non- print non-fiction materials that are interesting to read
2. read a range of non- fiction materials for general information

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
